props.name: as
props.description: Element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content or render function receiving the copy state.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: copiedIcon
props.description: Icon displayed during the `'copied'` state, in place of `icon`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state, including for non-button polymorphic roots.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon displayed in the idle and failed states. Pass `false` (or `null`) to hide the icon;
without children the button then has no visible content.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Position of the copy indicator icon relative to the label. Has no effect without children.

props.name: onCopyError
props.description:
Called when the copy fails, with the thrown or rejected error, or an `Error` when the
clipboard could not be written. The button then has `aria-invalid` until `resetDelay`
elapses.

props.name: onCopySuccess
props.description:
Called after the copy succeeds, with the resolved data that was written (after awaiting a
promise or calling a function `value`).

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description:
Called on every status change: `'idle'` when a copy starts, then `'copied'` or `'failed'`,
and `'idle'` again after `resetDelay`. `isCopied` is `true` only for `'copied'`.

props.name: resetDelay
props.description:
Delay in milliseconds before the `'copied'` or `'failed'` status returns to `'idle'`. While
the `'copied'` status is active the icon switches to `copiedIcon` and the default
`aria-label` changes to the localized "copied" message.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
What to copy on click: a string, a `ClipboardItem`, a `ClipboardItem[]`, a `Promise` of
either, or a function returning one. A function is called on every click and a promise is
awaited first; if it rejects or throws, the copy fails and `onCopyError` receives the error.
Non-string data is written with `navigator.clipboard.write`; the `execCommand` fallback can
only copy text.
examples:
import { CopyButton } from 'moraine'

<CopyButton
  value={async () => (await fetch('/api/share-link')).text()}
  onCopyError={(error) => console.error(error)}
>
  Copy share link
</CopyButton>
